title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Shared Vehicles - Route
description: The path traveled to get from an origin to a destination, for a shared vehicle trip (edintvc:Route).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Route'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

originDock.description: Relationship. The dock in a station from where the vehicle departed (edintvc:originDock).

destinationDock.description: Relationship. The dock in a station where the vehicle's route ends (edintvc:destinationDock).

originSpot.description: Relationship. The parking spot from where the vehicle's route starts (edintvc:originSpot), edint-aparcamiento's ParkingSpot.

destinationSpot.description: Relationship. The parking spot where the vehicle's route ends (edintvc:destinationSpot), edint-aparcamiento's ParkingSpot.

hasWaypoint.description: Relationship. The Waypoint(s) of this route, e.g. reported by a vehicle with GPS (edintvc:hasWaypoint).

madeByVehicle.description: Relationship. The SharedVehicle that made this route (edintvc:madeByVehicle).
